A guided half day of the city

Check in and the evening free in the old quarter
2: Breakfast and check out, then east towards the coast
Board your junk in the early afternoon
A night moored among the limestone islands
3: Breakfast on board as the boat moves
Back to the pier in the late morning
On to Hanoi and check in

4: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to the airport for your flight home

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Four days, one night at sea. For a first visit with little time, this is the pair of things worth doing.
expert.tip: Take the city tour on arrival day as it is scheduled here. It gets you oriented before you lose two days to the coast.

summary: A four day taste of the north: a guided half day of Hanoi on arrival, a night aboard a timber junk among the limestone islands of Halong Bay with all meals on board, then a last night back in the old quarter.
included: Included: 3 nights with breakfast daily and dinner at the Hanoi hotel, one night on a cruise boat with lunch and dinner; private transfers throughout; a guided half day tour of Hanoi; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; other lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
